_readme: Reconstructed format, same as the other provider modules. Not tested against a real spreadsheet. Watch out for the OAuth scope: if gcal's refresh token was generated with only the Calendar scope, this module will fail with 403 until consent is redone including https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.
description: Appends rows to a Google Sheets spreadsheet. Used by fika-sync (export_to_sheet, log_history) and by onboarding-automator (onboarding checklist). Requires GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET and GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN (with the spreadsheets scope).
